items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: J. Bart Johnson was a band director and he had a son that played drums and a little xylophone, so she talked to him if he'd give a few lessons. So I went over, lot of times I'd go over and he'd be playing a job the night before and I'd have to take -- get up at 4:00 in the morning to go over.

ctx.x: And when she was over there she stopped by a music store, Johnson's -- J. Bart Johnson, and J. Bart Johnson was a band director and he had a son that played drums and a little xylophone, so she talked to him if he'd give a few lessons. So I went over, lot of times I'd go over and he'd be playing a job the night before and I'd have to take -- get up at 4:00 in the morning to go over.
Why did it take so long?
